course_description: This course provides an overview of the Computing Industry and Computing profession, including Research and Applications in different fields; an Appreciation of Computing in different fields such as Biology, Sociology, Environment, and Gaming; an understanding of ACM requirements; an appreciation of the history of computing; and knowledge of the icy components of computer systems (organizations and architecture), Malware, Computer Security, Internet and Internet protocols, HTML4/5 and CSS.

explain the roles and responsibilities of the IT professional;

understand and apply the concepts involving framework for website development;
utilize design standards in planning the layout, design, and development of a complete website; and
Demonstrate 21st-century skills in all learning activities.
